name: In Living Color
description: Created by stars Keenen Ivory Wayans and Damon Wayans, this Emmy-winning sketch series offers cutting-edge satire and features a host of talent, including Jamie Foxx, Jim Carrey, David Alan Grier and Tommy Davidson.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: "Love Connection" host Chuck Woolery questions Robin Givens about her date with Mike Tyson; Redd Foxx gives tax tips. Also: "Men on Film."

videos.title: The Wrath of Farrakhan
videos.overview: Arsenio Hall welcomes Marion Barry to his show. Also: Keenen and Damon Wayans introduce the "Do-It-Yourself Milli Vanilli Kit."

videos.title: Lean On Me Beautiful
videos.overview: A beauty-school principal lays down the law; an inner-city Lassie saves Timmy and Mom from disaster; talk-show conversation turns intense.

videos.title: Transitions
videos.overview: "Men on Art"; Anton "entertains" a subway audience; parodies of Oprah and Billy Dee Williams.

videos.title: A Date With Grace Jones
videos.overview: Boxing greats find a child on their doorstep; a corporate climber hopes his date is suitable; a condo caters to a corpulent clientele; an interpreter introduces Ambassador Shirley Temple Black to her new post.

videos.title: Jheri's Kids
videos.overview: A picky karate instructor; a specific chemical dependency; the creative process of Tracy Chapman; a yuppie couple at an earthy eatery; a businessman trying to be young.

videos.title: Don King - The Early Years
videos.overview: "Men on Books"; a black leader's early years; the Jamaican sitcom "Hey Mon"; rappers Salt-n-Pepa hosting a cooking show; a wise men's-room attendant; a "colorized" classic from Ted Turner.

videos.title: Endangered Species
videos.overview: Anton gives home-remodeling tips; "President Jesse Jackson" holds a press conference; a domestic dispute at a salon takes its toll on a client; "Joan Embery" shows an endangered species to "Alan Thicke."

videos.title: Introducing...Homey D. Clown
videos.overview: Whizzer and Ice offer a seminar on making money; "Andrea Dice Clay" does her routine. Also: "America's Funniest Security Camera Videos."

videos.title: Vera DeMilo
videos.overview: An ad for a new celebrity toy; a forgetful Don Cornelius hosting "Old Train"; a female bodybuilding contest.

videos.title: Anton In The People's Court
videos.overview: Sketches include the homeless Anton defending himself in a people's court; a parody of rapper MC Hammer; Ted Turner's "colorized classic" version of "The Kid."

videos.title: Conspiracy
videos.overview: A cable repairman benefits when LaQuita tries to impress a producer. Also: a "Ray Charles in Charge" segment.

videos.title: Homey D. Clown Returns
videos.overview: Damon Wayans plays Homey the Clown; comedienne Samantha Kinison speaks on men and marriage.
